settings.question: Is Brant Business Interiors a Teknion dealer?
settings.answer: Yes. Brant Business Interiors is an authorized Teknion dealer serving Ontario. We specify, quote, deliver, and install the Teknion lines we carry — workstations, demountable and architectural wall systems, height-adjustable desking, and contract seating — for institutional and workplace clients, with delivery and installation by our own Ontario crew.

settings.question: Which Teknion lines does Brant Business Interiors carry?
settings.answer: The Teknion lines we carry today include Glass walls, Zones, Untethered, Chronicle, Expansion, Byward, AC Executive, AC Boardroom, Lounge, Boardroom, and Seating. We confirm current model availability, finish, and configuration on every quote. For other Teknion products, ask us — as an authorized dealer we can quote across the catalogue.

settings.question: Is Teknion a Canadian company?
settings.answer: Yes. Teknion is a Canadian contract-furniture manufacturer headquartered in Toronto, founded in 1983 by Saul Feldberg and led today by David Feldberg. It is the sister company to Global Furniture Group, both owned by the Feldberg family. Brant Business Interiors is a Canadian, family-owned dealer supplying Ontario workplaces since 1964.

settings.question: What is the lead time, and do you deliver and install across Ontario?
settings.answer: Teknion products are specified to order, so we confirm the exact lead time on your quote before your purchase order is issued. Brant Business Interiors delivers and installs across Ontario with our own team — workstations built and levelled, walls fitted, seating placed — coordinated with your site contact, with no third-party freight handoff. Call 1-800-835-9565 or request a quote and we will respond in one business day.

settings.question: Are Teknion products available to OECM buyers?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario broader-public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, and municipalities — can purchase office furniture and installation from us without an open tender. Family-owned and supplying Ontario workplaces since 1964, from 701 The Queensway, Units 2-4, Peterborough, ON K9J 7J6.
